title: GERMAN BISQUE HEADED CLOTH BOD...
reason: Good size, good quality moulded-hair German bisque lady doll with pierced ears and painted boots; comparable examples sell for several hundred dollars even with poor clothes.
findings: Large antique-style German bisque lady doll: bisque shoulder head with moulded blonde hair in an elaborate coiffure with a gold-lustre bow and band on top, painted blue eyes, rosy cheeks, closed mouth, pierced ears with drop pearl earrings; cloth body; bisque lower legs with black painted heeled boots. Dressed in a mauve silk gown with lace trim and sash. The style is that of the 1870s Parian-type fashion lady dolls. No marks are visible on the head, legs or anywhere else in the photos (back of the shoulder plate not shown), so the maker is not identified. The dress fabric (shredding silk) is consistent with age, but age cannot be proven from photos. Auction results seen for comparable blonde German bisque ladies on cloth bodies were about US$250 to $700 (Theriault's listings in search results 19/10/2026). Title (German bisque head, cloth body, silk dress, deteriorated, 53 cm) is supported by the photos.
condition: Face and hair look clean and undamaged, no cracks, chips or hairlines visible in the photos (neck and back of shoulders not shown). The gown is badly deteriorated with splits, missing sections and shredding; the cloth chest is stained pink from the dress. Hands and arms not visible.
rescore_note: Unmarked German Parian-type lady with moulded blonde hair, bow and band, pierced ears and painted boots, face clean; comparable blonde German bisque ladies sold US$250 to 650 at Theriault's (theriaults.com listings, 2014 to 2022, seen 19/10/2026), but the dress is ruined and age and maker are unproven; my estimate A$200 to 400.
